arms.note: Shipped default verbatim - SOP-017 days 16-30, four crew classes exempt, responder-only direction, uniform stewards, shared (0.05, 0.3) door-drop factor, messes open. First arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar; doubles as the widest crew-share corner (shipped baseline row).

The landed MEAL-SVC-02 corner verbatim: SOP-017-NARROW (messes open) + direction both + section stewards + CF_HOST_LO. Pairing base and drift witness vs the MEAL-SVC-02 landed row (confined-pax 35, crew share 0.841, deliveries ~162k) - NOT expected bit-identical across intervening merges; deliveries parity and the confined-pax band are the binding comparisons.

CANARY. Boxed crew meals for the order window: every crew placement into a crew-mess zone resolves to home_zone while the order is active (mess-posted staff exempt). Documented DP response; the strongest intervention and the loudest shared-zone-defect test.

Staggered crew service: rising-edge schedule surgery spreads each crew agent's Meal tokens over 4 seatings (agent_id % 4), restored at the falling edge. Documented DP-style stagger; occupancy per meal hour ~1/4.
Mess capacity limits: per-(zone, epoch) diner cap at 10% of rated occupancy (105 seats across both messes vs ~260-330 exempt crew); overflow eats boxed in cabin.

cells_note: 5 arms x 20 seeds. Seeded in-order per arm (20200205..20200224); each cell ~15 epochs/day over ~21 days with the voyage frozen.

admissibility.conditional_trajectory_clause: Seeds whose seeded case never completes takeoff produce no during-quarantine onset mass for reasons independent of the arm. The during-window median is computed on seeds that completed takeoff (onboard_infections > 0); takeoff_recorded_onsets remains an audit diagnostic (DP tally ~10), not a gate.
admissibility.crew_share_primary: During-window crew share vs the record 0.29 against the pre-declared target band (0.2, 0.4): inside = the mess channel carried the residual; above = residual elsewhere; below = over-closed.
admissibility.confined_pax_guard: Confined-passenger during-window mass holds the landed band ([26,160] context, landed median 35) within seed-paired noise on every arm; a passenger-side move is PAX-COLLATERAL, a shared-zone defect, not a finding.
admissibility.deliveries_parity: service_deliveries per cell within 15% of the landed row (~162k) - the meal-policy seam must not move the steward channel.

verdict_grammar.MESS-CHANNEL-CLOSED: armed arm lands crew share inside (0.2, 0.4) with the confined-pax band holding
verdict_grammar.STILL-HIGH: crew share moves measurably but lands > 0.4 - residual rides another venue
verdict_grammar.OVER-CLOSED: crew share < 0.2 - the declared intervention over-corrects
verdict_grammar.UNMOVED: crew share within seed-paired noise of the open arm - the mechanism never reached the mess
verdict_grammar.PAX-COLLATERAL: confined-pax mass departs the landed band beyond seed-paired noise - shared-zone defect
